verdict.rationale: Trivy's filesystem docs say it scans projects for vulnerabilities from lock files, naming Gemfile.lock (Ruby) and package-lock.json (npm), and it can generate SBOMs for local projects. The pack only shows these two ecosystems as examples, so breadth across all major languages is implied rather than documented. Missing for 10: a documented list of supported languages and package managers (e.g. Python, Java/Maven/Gradle, Go, Rust, .NET, PHP), detail on per-ecosystem detection accuracy, and independent hands-on corroboration of multi-language coverage.
